title.narrative: Inclusive Beverage Production and Distribution Project

description.narrative: The project will support RG Brands' Kazakhstan LLP (RGB) expansion across beverages through the financing of coolers for retail in both Kazakhstan and Kyrgyz Republic and production equipment and maintenance capex in Kazakhstan. The loan will provide long term financing in local currency not readily available in Kazakhstan market and support diversification of the economy by enhancing non-oil exports and improvement of livelihoods of stakeholders in the retail value chain.
